See how the climate has changed where you live.

Pick any place on Earth and read its historical climate data.

or open the world map

Colors
Represents the difference from that place’s usual value. Dark blue means cooler/drier, bright red means hotter/wetter.
Trend line
Shows the general climate trend for the years you select. With none selected, it fits the measured record.
Significant
There is strong statistical evidence that this location has experienced some upward or downward trend. However, this does not necessarily imply causation.
Projected
Extrapolates current trends to 2100, with a range showing uncertainty ranges. Note that this is not a climate model forecast. How projections work.
